caption: The drawing depicts a single, oval-shaped vessel with a glossy, reddish-brown surface, placed on a plain, beige background. The vessel has a wide, round opening at the top and a single curved handle attached to one side, forming a continuous arc from the body to just above the opening. The surface of the vessel appears smooth with subtle color variations in shades of brown and hints of purplish and yellowish tones, suggesting reflections or changes in the glaze. The object is centered on the page, and the artist's name, "FRITZ BOEHMER," is written in uppercase letters in the lower right corner. There are no other objects or designs present in the composition.
title: Zoar Fat Lamp
